baseline.statement: We have $r_*=0.2096\ldots$, and the following hold. \begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)] \item $V(r)=\Vbal(r)$ for every $r\in(0,1)$. In particular, $V(r)<h(r)$ if and only if $r<r_*$. \item For $r\in(r_*,1)$, the constant graphon $r$ is the unique minimizer. \item At $r=r_*$, the minimizers are exactly the constant graphon $r_*$ and the relabelings of $B_*=B_{a_*,b_*}$, where $a_*=0.01703\ldots$ and $b_*=0.8493\ldots$. \item Let $r\in(0,r_*)$. The minimum in \eqref{eq:Vbal} is attained at a unique pair $(a_r,b_r)$, which satisfies $0<a_r<r<b_r<1$. The minimizers at $r$ are exactly the relabelings of $B_{a_r,b_r}$. \end{enumerate}

baseline.statement: Let $U$ be a minimizer at $r\in(0,1)$, with multiplier $\mu_U$. \begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)] \item $U>0$ a.e. \item $U$ satisfies the \emph{Euler--Lagrange equation} \begin{equation} \log U=-\mu_UC_U\quad\text{a.e.} \end{equation} \item $\mu_U>0$ and $\mu_Ur^3=-\iint U\log U$. Moreover, $\mu_U$ is the only real number $\mu$ for which $\log U=-\mu C_U$ a.e. \item $e^{-\mu_U}\le U\le\exp(-\mu_Ue^{-2\mu_U})<1$ and $C_U\ge e^{-2\mu_U}$ a.e. \end{enumerate}

baseline.statement: \begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)] \item Let $D$ be a bounded measurable function on $[0,1]^2$. For all measurable $f,g:[0,1]\to[0,1]$, \[ \Big|\iint D(x,y)f(x)g(y)\dd x\dd y\Big|\le\|D\|_\cut. \] \item For all graphons $U$ and $W$, $|e(U)-e(W)|\le\|U-W\|_\cut$ and $|t(U)-t(W)|\le3\|U-W\|_\cut$. \item Every sequence of graphons has a subsequence $(U_n)$ for which there are measure preserving bijections $\varphi_n$ of $[0,1]$ and a graphon $U$ with $\|U_n^{\varphi_n}-U\|_\cut\to0$. \item For all kernels $U$, $Y$ and $W$ and every measure preserving $\varphi$, we have $\delta_\cut(U,W)=\delta_\cut(W,U)\le\delta_\cut(U,Y) +\delta_\cut(Y,W)$ and $\delta_\cut(W^\varphi,W)=0$. \end{enumerate}

baseline.statement: Let $a>0$, $s\ge0$, and let $W$ be a nonnegative kernel. Then $t(aW)=a^3t(W)$, \begin{align} F(aW)&=aF(W)+(a\log a)e(W)+1-a,\\ F(aW)-h(as)&=a\big(F(W)-h(s)\big)+(a\log a)\big(e(W)-s\big). \end{align}

baseline.statement: Let $W$ be a nonnegative kernel and $W'=\min(W,1)$. Then $W'$ is a graphon, $t(W')\le t(W)$, and $F(W')\le F(W)$ with strict inequality if $|\{W>1\}|>0$. Hence, for $r\in(0,1)$, every nonnegative kernel $W$ with $t(W)\le r^3$ satisfies $F(W)\ge V(r)$, with equality only if $W\le1$ a.e. Thus $V(r)$ is also the infimum of $F$ over such kernels.

baseline.statement: Let $z\in(0,1)$ with $\Gamma\ne0$. Let $U$ be a graphon with $t(U)=t_z$. Assume that $U\ge\ell$ a.e.\ for some $\ell>0$ and that $\log U=-\tilde\mu C_U$ a.e.\ for some $\tilde\mu\in\R$. Let $X,Y,Z$ be as in \eqref{s8:rewrite}. Then \begin{align} \E[\Psi_z(X,Y,Z)]&=3c_1\big(e(U)-m\big)\notag\\ &\quad+3(\mu-\tilde\mu)\Big[c_2t_z+c_3\iint C_U+c_4\iint U\log U C_U\Big]. \end{align} In particular $\Psi_z(a,a,a)+3\Psi_z(a,b,b)=0$.
